SELECT DISTINCT ?b ?bname WHERE { ?b a brick:Building . ?b rdfs:label ?bname . }

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?p ?pclass WHERE { ?p a brick:ElectricPowerSensor . }

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/core/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?p ?pclass WHERE { ?p a brick:ElectricPowerSensor . }
SELECT DISTINCT ?p ?pclass WHERE { ?p a ?pclass . FILTER(str(?pclass) != "")} LIMIT 50
SELECT DISTINCT ?p ?pclass WHERE { ?p a ?pclass . FILTER(str(?pclass) != "") } FILTER(str(?pclass) LIKE "%Power%")

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?zone ?label ?tsid WHERE {
  ?sensor a brick:Electric_Power_Sensor .
  ?sensor brick:isPointOf ?zone .
  ?zone a brick:HVAC_Zone .
  ?zone brick:hasPoint ?sensor .
  ?sensor ref:hasExternalReference ?r .
  FILTER(str(?r) LIKE "%tsref%")
  BIND(REPLACE(str(?r), ".*tsref:([0-9a-f-]+)$", "$1") AS ?tsid)
  OPTIONAL{ ?zone rdfs:label ?label . }
}
